title: RJI Professional Innovation Fellowships
about: The Donald W. Reynolds Journalism Institute (RJI), United States, accepts first-round applications for its 2027 Professional Innovation Fellowships from 2 November 2026 to 8 January 2027. The eight-month fellowship begins 28 June 2027 with an in-person kickoff at RJI.
card_alt: Card for the "RJI Professional Innovation Fellowships" from the Donald W. Reynolds Journalism Institute (RJI), Columbia, Missouri, United States; deadline 8 Jan 2027. The photo shows the Statue of Liberty and the Manhattan skyline in New York, not Columbia.
